title: We had a great experience...
text: We had a great experience discovering Seville by bike. It was the best way to learn this wonderful city. Our guide, Francisco was both knowledgeable of the city and sensitive to our needs. He wanted to make sure we were getting everything out of the tour we wanted. He cared. We appreciated our experience very much. Thank you Francisco!
author: Jeff_M

title: Valter was amazing.  Very personable and knowledgeable about the city and culture.  Biking around the city was fun.
text: Valter was amazing.  He is very personable and knowledgeable about the city and culture.  Biking is a great way to see the city!
author: Global639782

title: Great way to see and taste Seville
text: A really pleasurable cycling tour around Seville with our super friendly and knowledgeable guide, Miguel. Three really cool local tapas spots to stop at for a varied tasting experience amongst the lively pre Seville football derby crowd. Great atmosphere and food/drink. The city centre is very cycling friendly too. Only complaint is that we didn’t do it sooner! Highly recommend.
author: S9028LAsimonm

title: Alfredo was really friendly and relaxed
text: Great tour, nice and laid back. The streets are repeats and safe to ride. Cycle lanes all the way. The food was delicious, the drinks were great and history made for a good overview
